teaser.en: Under its spiny green skin, the soursop hides soft white pulp that tastes like pineapple and strawberry with a sour twist.
teaser.sw: Chini ya ganda lake la kijani lenye miiba, mstafeli huficha nyama laini nyeupe yenye ladha ya nanasi na stroberi pamoja na uchachu kidogo.
teaser.dg: Ndani ya gadare ra chijani renye miya, *soursop* unafwitsa nyama nyereru laini, yenye ladha dza nanasi na *strawberry* na ngbwadu chidide.

summary.en: Soursop is a small homestead tree with spiny green fruit and white, tangy pulp. It is grown for fruit and juice and used in medicine.
summary.sw: Mstafeli ni mti mdogo wa nyumbani wenye matunda ya kijani yenye miiba na nyama nyeupe yenye ladha chachu. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya matunda na sharubati na hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Soursop* ni muhi mdide wa mudzini wenye matunda ga chijani genye miya na nyama nyereru ya ngbwadu chidide. Unaphandwa kpwa matundage na kuhenda vinwadzi, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en: Soursop is a small evergreen tree with glossy, dark green leaves. The fruit is large and heart- or oval-shaped, with a green skin covered in soft, curved spines. Inside, the white pulp is soft and fibrous, with a sweet-sour taste, and holds many shiny black seeds.
about.sw: Mstafeli ni mti mdogo wa kijani kibichi daima wenye majani yanayong'aa ya kijani iliyokolea. Tunda ni kubwa, la umbo la moyo au la yai, lenye ganda la kijani lililofunikwa kwa miiba laini iliyopinda. Ndani, nyama nyeupe ni laini yenye nyuzi, yenye ladha tamu-chachu, na ina mbegu nyingi nyeusi zinazong'aa.
about.dg: *Soursop* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza chila wakati, ganayong'ala na ga chijani sana. Tunda ni kulu, ra umbo ra moyo au ra tumbi, na gada ra chijani renye miya laini iriyofyuka. Ndani, nyama nyereru ni laini na ya nyuzi-nyuzi, ya mtswano na ngbwadu, na ina tembe nyinji nyiru zinazong'ala.

where.en: It is grown as a homestead tree.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten and made into juice. The plant is also used in medicine.
uses.sw: Tunda huliwa na hutengenezwa sharubati. Mmea pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg: Tunda nkuriwa na nkuhendwa vinwadzi. Mmea piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *mstafeli*. In English it is soursop.
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kiswahili huuita *mstafeli*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *soursop*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mstafeli*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *soursop*.

reason.en: Same genus; the wild custard apple
reason.dg: Wa jenasi mwenga; mbokwe, custard apple wa tsaka

reason.en: Another homestead fruit used for juice
reason.sw: Mpera, tunda jingine la nyumbani linalotumika kwa sharubati
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra mudzini rinarohendwa vinwadzi
